title: Thick points under Gaussian free field dynamics
summary: We investigate the evolution of thick points under two natural dynamics for the Gaussian free field (GFF) in dimension 2. The first dynamic we analyze is the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck GFF. We prove that, simultaneously for all points, the evolution of their thickness is continuous. Additionally, we characterize all deterministic functions $f: \mathbb{R}\rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ such that there are points whose thickness function is $f$.
